answer: Commit-reveal answering: in the first 10 minutes of an epoch each ID posts only a cipher, hash(answer + salt). Text is revealed after commits lock, and a reveal with no matching on-time commit earns 0. No farm can wait for the prize-winning violet answer and paraphrase it across 500 keys; every key must mix its own pigment from scratch, so farm cost grows linearly with keys. The 10-minute window and zero-payout rule are proposals, not measured; checking a SHA-256 hash costs microseconds per reveal.
